origin.description: Fits a cumulative link model from a response factor and a design matrix (Newton method, logit, probit, cloglog, loglog and cauchit links).
origin.usage: clm.fit(y, X, S, N, weights, offset, S.offset, control, start, doFit, link, threshold)
origin.details: Fits a cumulative link model from a response factor and a design matrix (Newton method, logit, probit, cloglog, loglog and cauchit links).
origin.value: The same value R returns for this call.
origin.example:
data(wine)
y <- wine$rating
X <- model.matrix(~ contact + temp, data = wine)
fit <- clm.fit(y = y, X = X)
fit$coefficients
